seo.title: The Grove Restaurant Ajman | Mangrove Views, Sunset Dining & Levantine Grills
seo.description: The Grove, Al Ittihad Street, Al Jerf 1, Ajman: international and Levantine cuisine with floor-to-ceiling views over Ajman's mangroves and flamingos, breakfast to late-night shisha. Open 8 AM to 1 AM. 4.5 from 2,933 reviews.

hero.kicker: Al Ittihad Street · Al Jerf 1 · Ajman
hero.lede: International and Levantine plates, breakfast to late-night shisha, served on a deck facing Ajman's mangroves and lagoons, where flamingos come in at sunset.
hero.image_alt: Sunset over the mangroves seen from The Grove's glass-walled dining room
